title: SubscriptionList resource
description: SubscriptionList entry (MG 8.3.9) and the SubscriptionList DataSetMessage of Pub, Set and Del SubscriptionList (MG 9.1.9). Rules of the rule layer: the WriterGroupName derived from the TopicPath (REQ-RES-SUBLIST-002, R-3), WriterGroupName = topic Filter (REQ-MSG-025, R-2), DataSetWriterName = topic Source (REQ-MSG-023, R-2).

SubscriptionEntry.$comment: REQ-RES-SUBLIST-001 (MG 8.3.9, SF-080): fields of a SubscriptionList entry: TopicPath, optional Interval and Config

allOf.$comment: REQ-RES-SUBLIST-002 (MG 8.3.9, SF-080): the resource level of an OEC TopicPath is concrete (neither + nor covered by #); topic filters outside the OEC namespace are not checked

unevaluatedProperties.$comment: REQ-MSG-001 (MG 8): a sender adds no key beyond the guideline (strict); the tolerant flavor drops this closure

WriterGroupName.$comment: REQ-MSG-025 (MG 8.2.3, GL-ADR-018): the WriterGroupName of a list entry is <ResourceType>[/<Tag>]
